card.summary: Z-Image base with the NippleDiffusion LoRA applied (NSFW). Full CFG + negative prompts; same detailed natural-language prompting as the Z-Image base.
use_cases: quality general generation with CFG control
card.pick_when: You want Z-Image with the NippleDiffusion LoRA.

prompt.example: A young woman in a red hanfu with gold embroidery under soft night lighting, a silhouetted pagoda blurred in the background, cinematic, highly detailed
prompt.overview: Non-distilled base of the Z-Image family: same detailed natural-language prompting, but full CFG and negative prompts ARE supported -- use guidance ~3.0-5.0 and 28-50 steps.
prompt.instructions: Same natural-language prose style and bilingual EN/ZH text as Turbo, but as a non-distilled base it supports full CFG and responds with high fidelity to negative prompting (use negatives to suppress artifacts / unwanted content). Recommended: guidance_scale 3.0-5.0, 28-50 steps, resolution 512-2048 (any aspect). A cfg_normalization toggle exists (False for stylized output, True for realism). Unlike Turbo, do not use guidance_scale 0.
do: Use negative prompts to remove artifacts
Toggle cfg_normalization True for realism / False for stylization
examples: A photorealistic portrait of an elderly fisherman mending a net at dawn on a wooden dock, soft golden side-light, weathered hands, detailed wool sweater, shallow depth of field, calm harbor with moored boats in the background
prompt.negative_guidance: Supported and effective -- leave empty by default, populate to suppress artifacts / unwanted content (e.g. 'blurry, deformed hands, extra fingers, watermark').

speed.measured_note: ~197s for the first image at default settings (1024x1024, 40 steps, cold: includes model load); repeats with the same model are faster.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two, like you'd tell ChatGPT. More detail usually looks better.
ui_help.good_for: modern realistic images with more control
